facts.text: In 1868, the English printer John Barnes Linnett patented a small book of pictures that he called the kineograph; the name means moving picture. It is now known as the flip book.
A Frenchman, Pierre-Hubert Desvignes, had a similar idea around 1860, before Linnett's patent.
In a flip book, each page shows one frame, and each picture moves the scene on a little from the picture before it.
When the pages are flipped quickly, the separate pictures seem to move because the eye blends them together (persistence of vision).
Because each page works like a frame of film, flip books pointed the way to motion pictures.
In the 1906 film Humorous Phases of Funny Faces, J. Stuart Blackton filmed himself drawing pictures and then made the pictures move through animation.
The French artist Emile Cohl made the short film Fantasmagorie from roughly 700 drawings; it runs for about one minute and 45 seconds.
Winsor McCay first showed Gertie the Dinosaur at the Palace theater in Chicago on February 2, 1914.
McCay made the film part of a live stage show: he stood on the stage with a whip, gave Gertie orders, and appeared to feed her an apple.
Audiences of the time were not used to films, and many people believed Gertie was real.
Some critics call Gertie the first cartoon character with a personality of her own.
To save drawing time, McCay reused the same series of drawings; to show Gertie breathing, he filmed one set of drawings up to fifteen times.
McCay's earlier film Little Nemo (1911) used about four thousand drawings.
Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs (1937) was the first American feature-length animated film.
More than 750 Disney artists worked on Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs between 1934 and 1937, about three years.
Emile Cohl's Fantasmagorie came out not long after Blackton's 1906 film Humorous Phases of Funny Faces.
facts.note: 只有先後順序；Fantasmagorie 的確切年份仍未在白名單來源確認（見 notes）

facts.text: Many people in the audience thought Gertie was real because they were not used to watching films.

notes: Fantasmagorie 的年份（一般寫 1908）未在可開啟的白名單來源確認，文章不寫年份；它排在 Blackton 1906 年短片之後的先後順序見 f16。f11 只是「有些評論者」的說法（s2），而 s4 說第一個真正的動畫明星是 Felix the Cat，所以題組不可把葛蒂寫成「最有名的早期卡通明星」這類不帶保留的最高級事實（ai.rd.801b10 因此被 fact_check 退回；重生的 ai.rd.26cf17 寫成「有些評論者說……」）。f16、f17 是重生時補的。
